title: Preparations begin for ‘Vijayawada Utsav’ and ‘Saras Mela’, says MP
description: Kesineni Sivanath announces ‘Vijayawada Utsav’ will be held from October 11 to 20 and the Saras Mela from October 8 to 23; events will be held mainly at the 18-acre Punnami Ghat, with several programmes also planned at the Makineni Basavapunnaiah Stadium
